annotations.title: Make a collection for a brand

description: Makes (or fills) a collection for a brand program: every link in the workspace that goes to the brand's site, or carries its code, plus the program's own bio link (brand_program_to_bio). Titled with the brand's name. Add product links first with link_create.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: bio_collection_fill_from_program
title: Make a collection for a brand
